known_extraction_limitations: Inline mathematical expressions and fractions rendered as vector graphics/SVG glyphs (e.g., x-bar, summation fractions) are omitted by pypdf plain-text extraction, leaving blank spaces in formula lines.
Charts and diagrams (histograms, box plots, tree diagrams, Venn diagrams) are graphical figures; only figure captions and surrounding explanatory text are extracted.
